title: Star Wars: Ahsoka season 2 and Starfighter get teased at D23
summary: Season two of Star Wars: Ahsoka is still months away, but Lucasfilm still took the opportunity to tease it a bit at D23 . Ryan Gosling also took the stage at D23 to tease the upcoming Star Wars: Starfighter movie.
